auth.signupDisabled: Accounts are created by an administrator.
auth.passwordDisabled: Password sign-in is turned off on this server.
auth.firstAdminHint: The first account created becomes the administrator.
auth.pendingBody: Your account ({{email}}) has been created. An administrator needs to approve it before you can start chatting.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

chat.noModelsAdmin: Add a connection in Admin → Connections to start chatting.
chat.noModelsUser: Ask an administrator to set up a model.
chat.deleteBody: "{{title}}" and all its messages will be deleted.
chat.deleteFolderBody: The folder "{{name}}" is deleted; its chats stay, outside any folder.
chat.notFound: This chat doesn't exist or isn't yours.
chat.feedbackTitle: What was wrong with this reply?
chat.temporaryHelp: Not saved in your chat list, no title, deleted after a day without activity.
chat.keepHelp: Save it to your chat list like any other chat
chat.systemPromptHelp: Added after your own and the folder's system prompts. Empty fields use your preferences.
chat.shareHelp: Anyone with the link can read the messages shown now, without signing in. Messages you add later are only shared when you update the link. Tool screens and attachment contents aren't shared.
chat.compacted_one: The first exchange was summarized to fit the context
chat.compacted_other: The first {{count}} exchanges were summarized to fit the context

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.directoryAccount: This account signs in through your organization's directory.
settings.toolsHelp: Switch on the tools the model may use in your chats. Built-in tools work in your own private workspace.
settings.filesHelp: Files you attached to messages. Deleting one removes it from the chats that used it.
settings.ownConnectionsHelp: Use your own API keys. Their models appear as @prefix/model and only you can use them.
settings.ownConnectionsOff: Your administrator does not allow personal connections. You can still delete ones you added earlier.
settings.exportHelp: All your chats (not temporary ones) as one Claudia JSON file, with every version of every message.
settings.importHelp: Claudia exports, Claudia desktop conversations (choose the conversations folder; add the projects folder's files for folder names), Open WebUI chat exports and ChatGPT's conversations.json. Attachments come along by name only.
settings.importProblems_one: {{count}} file or chat could not be read
settings.importProblems_other: {{count}} files or chats could not be read

admin.title: Administration
admin.deleteUserBody: {{email}} and all their chats will be deleted.
admin.prefixHelp: Models from this connection are named <prefix>/<model>.
admin.baseUrlHelp: Leave empty for the provider's default.
admin.insecureTls: Skip TLS certificate verification (self-signed or internal CA)
admin.insecureTlsHelp: The connection is still encrypted, but the server's identity isn't checked: anyone who can intercept traffic to it can read the API key and the conversations. Use it only on a network you trust.
admin.apiKeyKeep: Saved key ending in {{last4}}. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.apiKeySet: A key is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.modelFilterHelp: Comma-separated model ids. Empty = everything the endpoint lists.
admin.toolsFirstTurnOnly: Offer tools only on the first request (needed by some proxies)
admin.deleteConnectionBody: Chats that use its models can no longer get replies from them.
admin.concurrentRuns: Replies a user can have running at once
admin.toolServersHelp: MCP servers available to everyone. Users switch them on or off for themselves.
admin.deleteToolServerBody: Nobody will be able to use its tools any more.
admin.stdioWarning: A stdio server runs a command on this server machine. It gets only its own environment variables, never the server’s secrets. Requires CLAUDIA_ALLOW_STDIO_MCP=true.
admin.headers: HTTP headers (Name: value, one per line)
admin.secretsStored: Saved: {{names}}. Leave empty to keep them; entering values replaces them all.
admin.secretsHelp: Values are stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin.builtinToolsHelp: Each user gets their own copy, confined to a private workspace on this server.

builtins.builtin-filesystem-001: Files (read and write in the workspace)

admin.netAllowlistHelp: Web fetch and personal connections can only reach public addresses. List hosts (exact or *.domain) or address ranges (CIDR) to allow, one per line.
admin.ldapEnabled: Allow sign-in with directory accounts (LDAP / Active Directory)
admin.ldapBindModeSearch: Search with a service account, then bind as the user
admin.ldapBindModeDirect: Direct bind as user@domain (Active Directory, no service account)
admin.ldapCaCert: CA certificate (PEM), if not publicly trusted
admin.ldapBindDnHelp: Used to look users up. Leave empty for anonymous search.
admin.ldapBaseDnDirectHelp: Users sign in with their username; Claudia binds as {{example}}.
admin.ldapBaseDnNoDomain: Needs a sign-in domain, or dc= parts in the base DN (e.g. dc=example,dc=com): they make the sign-in domain.
admin.ldapSignInDomainHelp: The domain added when a user types only their username (their UPN suffix, e.g. app.example.com). Leave empty to use the base DN's dc= parts. Names typed with a domain are used as typed.
admin.ldapDirectNote: A direct bind doesn't search the directory, so there's no allowed group, group sync, user lookup or re-check of signed-in users. A new account gets the username as its name and username@domain as its email.
admin.ldapAllowedGroupHelp: Checked with memberOf. Leave empty to allow everyone the filter finds.
admin.ldapTestOk: Connected and signed in as the service account.
admin.ldapLookupMatches_one: {{count}} entry matches; sign-in needs exactly one.
admin.ldapLookupMatches_other: {{count}} entries match; sign-in needs exactly one.
admin.resetMfaHelp: Turn off their two-factor sign-in (for a lost phone); they can set it up again.
admin.compactionHelp: Near the model's context limit, summarize the oldest exchanges instead of leaving them out.
admin.compactionThreshold: Start at this share of the context (%)
admin.compactionKeep: Recent exchanges always kept word for word
admin.memoryHelp: Users can switch learning off for themselves. Sensitive topics are only saved for users who allow them.
admin.memoryTools: Let the model save memories during chats (the model must support tools)
admin.memoryExtraction: Learn memories from chats once they go quiet

share.notFound: This link doesn't exist or was deleted.

access.groupsHelp: Members get the permissions, models and higher caps of their groups on top of the defaults.
access.deleteGroupBody: Members of "{{name}}" lose what the group gives them, and items shared with it are no longer shared.
access.groupModelsAll: Users may use every model (Admin → Settings), so groups add none.
access.groupModelsHelp: Models members may use besides the ones every user may use.
access.groupCapsHelp: A cap set here replaces the default for members when it is higher.
access.addMember: Add someone by name or email…
access.defaultPermissionsHelp: Every approved user gets these. Groups can add more; admins can do everything.
access.defaultCapsHelp: Per user, in UTC days and months. Costs count where the provider reports them. Empty means no limit; admins are never capped.
access.usageHelp: Days and months are counted in UTC.
access.overrideCaps: Set caps for this user only (instead of the defaults and groups)
access.shareHelp: Only you (and admins) can see it until you share it.
access.addPerson: Add a person by name or email…
access.groupSyncHelp: At each sign-in, directory users join and leave the groups linked to their directory groups (Admin → Groups). Members added by hand stay.
access.groupFilterHelp: {{dn}} is the user's DN, {{username}} the sign-in name. Nested AD groups: (member:1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941:={{dn}})
access.adminGroupDnHelp: Members become admins at sign-in; directory users not in it lose admin (never the last admin). Empty: roles are managed here.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.modelsHelp: Assistants on a base model with their own instructions, settings, tools and starter prompts. A shared model runs with its owner's model access.
workspace.deleteModelBody: "{{name}}" will no longer be available to anyone. Chats that used it keep their messages.
workspace.name: Name
workspace.toolsHelp: Switched on whenever this model answers, for people who can use the server.
workspace.suggestionsHelp: One per line (up to 8), shown on a new chat.
workspace.promptsHelp: Type / in the message box to use them. {{name}} and {{name:default}} are asked for before the text goes in.
workspace.deletePromptBody: /{{command}} will no longer be available to anyone.
workspace.promptBodyHelp: Put {{name}} where something should be asked for, {{name:default}} with a default. {{CURRENT_DATE}} and {{USER_NAME}} fill themselves in.
workspace.knowledgeHelp: Searched whenever this model answers, with your access (people using the model don't need their own).

memory.help: What chats know about you. It is sent to the model with each message, and can be learned from your chats.
memory.placeholder: e.g. I work in Python and prefer short answers
memory.learnHelp: Lasting facts you mention (your work, preferences, projects) are saved here. Temporary chats are never used. Every change shows under the reply, where you can undo it.
memory.sensitiveHelp: Health, finances, religion, politics and similar topics are skipped unless this is on.
memory.importHelp: Paste what another assistant remembers about you (for example ChatGPT’s list under Settings → Personalization → Manage memories). Each line becomes a memory, sorted into a topic.
memory.imported: Added {{added}}, skipped {{skipped}} (duplicates, sensitive or over the limit).

apiKeys.help: Use the models you have here from other apps with an OpenAI-compatible API, including Claudia desktop as a custom provider.
apiKeys.notAllowed: Your administrator has not allowed API keys for you.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.copyNow: Copy the key now: it is shown only once.

ownTools.title: Your own servers
ownTools.help: Remote MCP servers (HTTP or SSE) that only you can use. Private network addresses are blocked unless the administrator allows them.
ownTools.name: Name
ownTools.headersKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored headers

refs.webPageHelp: Read a page or YouTube video with this message
refs.urlHelp: The page (or YouTube video transcript) is read and its relevant parts are sent with your message.
refs.nothing: No knowledge bases or chats match
refs.webSearchHelp: Search the web for this message and cite the results

knowledge.help: Documents chats can search and cite. Type # in a message to use one, or attach it to a folder or a custom model.
knowledge.notFound: This knowledge base was not found.
knowledge.searchKeyword: Searched by keywords (an admin can turn on embeddings for search by meaning)
knowledge.dropHelp: Drop PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, Markdown or text files here.
knowledge.tryPlaceholder: What would a chat find for…
knowledge.chunkHelp: Empty uses the defaults. Changing them processes every file again.
knowledge.fullContext: Send whole documents when they fit
knowledge.fullContextHelp: Instead of the most relevant passages. Good for a few short documents.
knowledge.deleteBody: "{{name}}" and its index will be deleted. The files stay in your files.
knowledge.sourcesHelp: Keep a repository’s documentation in this knowledge base and sync it when it changes.
knowledge.pathsHelp: One per line, e.g. docs/ or README.md. Empty: the whole repository. Only documents, text and code files are taken, up to 500.
knowledge.tokenHelp: A fine-grained token with read access to the repository’s contents. It is stored encrypted.

folder.systemPromptPlaceholder: Instructions for every chat in this folder
folder.knowledgeHelp: Searched for every chat in this folder and its subfolders.
folder.noKnowledge: You have no knowledge bases yet (Workspace → Knowledge).
folder.sharedViewer: {{name}} shared this folder with you. Your chats in it use its instructions and knowledge; only you see them.
folder.sharedEditor: {{name}} shared this folder with you and lets you change its instructions and knowledge. Your chats in it are yours only.
folder.ownerKnowledge_one: Also {{count}} knowledge base the owner added.
folder.ownerKnowledge_other: Also {{count}} knowledge bases the owner added.

rag.title: Knowledge
rag.embeddingsHelp: With embeddings, knowledge is searched by meaning as well as keywords. Without them, keyword search still works.
rag.keyStored: A key is stored; leave empty to keep it.
rag.localMissing: Local embeddings need the @huggingface/transformers package on the server.
rag.changeWarning: Changing the engine or model indexes every knowledge base and memory again.
rag.webSearchHelp: Lets people search the web from a chat (the globe button) and cite the results.
rag.fetchPages: Read the result pages (not just the snippets)
rag.savedReindexing: Saved. Everything is being indexed again.

tools.codeHelp: Let the model run Python in your browser (in a sandbox) for calculations and data

artifacts.noSandbox: Live previews need a sandbox origin (CLAUDIA_SANDBOX_ORIGIN).

voice.micDenied: The microphone is blocked for this site.

media.title: Media
media.imagesHelp: Lets people ask for images in a chat (the image button above the message box). Images are kept as their files.
media.voiceHelp: The browser's own speech works without a server and keeps audio away from Claudia; an OpenAI-compatible API (Whisper, TTS) works in every browser.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.help: Renderer plugins change how messages are shown. They run with full access to the page for everyone, so install only plugins you trust.
plugins.formatHelp: The bundle is an ES module whose default export is the plugin object (the desktop plugin API). It may import react, react/jsx-runtime and unified.
plugins.pickBoth: Choose the manifest and the bundle.
plugins.reloadHelp: People see changes after reloading the page.

openapi.title: OpenAPI tool servers
openapi.help: Each operation of an OpenAPI 3 spec becomes a tool. Calls go to the API with the header you set.
openapi.specText: Or paste the spec (JSON or YAML)

banners.title: Banners
banners.help: Notices shown at the top of every page for signed-in users. Leave the dates empty to show a banner until you remove it.

defaults.title: Defaults for users
defaults.help: What every user's appearance and preferences are until they change them in their own settings. Unset fields keep the app's built-in defaults.
defaults.systemPromptHelp: Sent first in every chat of a user who hasn't written their own.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.utcNote: Days are in UTC. Costs count only where the provider reports them.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.help: Claudia POSTs JSON to these addresses when something happens. Every delivery is signed with the webhook’s secret (HMAC-SHA256), so the receiver can check it came from here. Failed deliveries are retried twice.
webhooks.name: Name

events.user_updated: A user's role or name changed

webhooks.secretHelp: Copy it now: it is shown only this once. Store it with the receiver; you can make a new one at any time.
webhooks.verifyHelp: Compute the HMAC over the raw request body, exactly as received, and compare it with the X-Claudia-Signature header.

mfa.title: Two-factor sign-in
mfa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.recoveryHint: Lost your phone? A recovery code works once. Or ask an administrator to reset two-factor sign-in.
mfa.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, …), then enter the code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
mfa.recoveryShownOnce: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
mfa.isOff: Off. Signing in will also ask for a code from your phone once you turn it on.
mfa.requiredBody: Your administrator requires two-factor sign-in. Set it up to continue.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.mfaHelp: Who must use a code from an authenticator app when signing in with a password, the directory or single sign-on.
signin.mfaEffect: People without it are asked to set it up before they can use Claudia. API keys are not affected.
signin.ssoHelp: Let people sign in with Microsoft Entra ID, Google, Okta, Keycloak, Authentik or any OpenID Connect provider. Register the redirect URI below with the provider.
signin.deleteBody: People can no longer sign in with {{name}}. Their accounts stay.
signin.name: Button name
signin.linkByEmail: Link to an existing account with the same verified email
signin.linkByEmailHelp: Only when you trust the provider to verify email addresses. Accounts created by SCIM or an admin without a password link either way.
signin.groupsHelp: Values of the groups claim decide membership of Claudia groups with the same names; listed admin groups make someone an administrator.
signin.scimHelp: Let your identity provider create, update and deactivate accounts and groups. Give it the URL and a token.
signin.scimTokenOnce: Copy this token now; it is shown only once:

arena.title: Evaluations
arena.settingsHelp: Users can pick "Arena (blind)": two of these models answer without their names, and the user votes for the better reply before seeing which was which.
arena.leaderboardHelp_one: Elo ratings from {{count}} vote (everyone starts at 1000).
arena.leaderboardHelp_other: Elo ratings from {{count}} votes (everyone starts at 1000).
arena.question: Which reply is better?
arena.revealed: A was {{a}}, B was {{b}}. You picked {{picked}}.

cloud.adminHelp: Let people add files from their Google Drive or OneDrive to chats and knowledge. Each person connects their own account; Claudia only reads the files they pick.
cloud.googleHelp: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services: enable the Drive API, create an OAuth client (web application) with the redirect URI above.
cloud.microsoftHelp: Entra ID → App registrations: add the redirect URI (Web) and the delegated Microsoft Graph permissions Files.Read.All and User.Read, then create a client secret.
cloud.addFrom: Add from Google Drive or OneDrive
cloud.connectHelp: Connect your {{name}} to pick files from it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.pick: Pick a note or start a new one.
notes.askInChat: Ask about it in a chat
notes.deleteBody: "{{title}}" will be deleted for everyone it is shared with.

channels.title: Channels
channels.name: Name
channels.newHelp: Then choose who is in it with "Members" (or everyone).
channels.notFound: This channel doesn't exist or you're not in it.
channels.empty: No messages yet. Say hello, or ask a model with @.
channels.placeholder: Message the channel (type @ to ask a model)
channels.deleteBody: #{{name}} and all its messages will be deleted.

schedules.title: Scheduled prompts
schedules.help: Prompts sent for you on a schedule, such as a morning briefing. Each reply appears in a chat.
schedules.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will stop running. Its chats stay.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.cronHelp: Cron fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. "30 7 * * 1-5" is 7:30 on weekdays. At most every 15 minutes.

workspaceFiles.title: Workspace
workspaceFiles.help: Files the built-in Files, Word and Diagrams tools read and write. To save something in a particular place, say so in your message, e.g. "save it as reports/q3.md". Files a reply writes are also linked under it.
workspaceFiles.deleteFileBody: The file is deleted from your workspace. Replies that link to it can no longer download it.
workspaceFiles.deleteFolderBody: The folder and everything in it are deleted from your workspace.

mcpOAuth.useHelp: For servers that ask you to sign in (MCP authorization). After saving, press Connect and sign in in the window that opens. Tokens are stored encrypted and refreshed automatically.
mcpOAuth.advancedHelp: Only if the server doesn’t let apps register themselves: the client ID (and secret) you got from it, with this callback address: /api/mcp/oauth/callback on this site.
